_note: 自我介绍深挖:现有偏商务社交(工作足),补齐 学习/家庭/爱好 三维度并深挖工作。往现有 4 档 append(不新建档)。单人自我介绍,女声 Rosie。难度对齐现有档。

beginner.en: In my free time, I like hiking.
I'm learning to play the piano.

intermediate.en: Outside of work, I'm really into photography.
intermediate.zh: 工作之外，我很喜欢摄影。

intermediate.en: I'm the eldest of three kids.
intermediate.zh: 我是三个孩子里的老大。

intermediate.en: I'm doing a part-time master's in design.
intermediate.zh: 我在读设计的在职硕士。

intermediate.en: My work is mostly about solving problems for users.
intermediate.zh: 我的工作主要是为用户解决问题。

intermediate.en: My parents live nearby, so we have dinner together often.
intermediate.zh: 父母住得近，我们常一起吃饭。

intermediate.en: On weekends, I usually go rock climbing.

advanced.en: I've recently gotten into long-distance running — it's become a bit of an obsession.
advanced.zh: 最近我迷上了长跑，有点上瘾了。

advanced.en: I'm juggling a full-time role with an evening MBA.
advanced.zh: 我一边做全职工作，一边读晚间 MBA。

advanced.en: I come from a family of teachers, so education runs deep for me.
advanced.zh: 我出身教师家庭，所以对教育有很深的情结。

advanced.en: My work has shifted more toward mentoring junior designers lately.
advanced.zh: 最近我的工作更多转向带初级设计师。

advanced.en: When I'm not working, you'll usually find me experimenting in the kitchen.
advanced.zh: 不工作的时候，我多半在厨房捣鼓吃的。

advanced.en: My partner and I just moved into a place closer to my parents.
advanced.zh: 我和伴侣刚搬到离我父母更近的地方。
